purpose: Add an app-owned ingestion runner that copies a normalized external response into an auditable incoming case directory, runs the Goal5330 validator, and writes manifest, validation_result, and next_action files.

exit_codes.3: case directory already exists and --overwrite was not supplied

behavior_locked_by_tests: valid positive archive response creates an auditable case and returns 0
invalid template response is still recorded and returns 2
duplicate case id fails closed with return code 3

pod_usage.reason: Local intake runner only. POD is used only in a later provenance-ingestion goal after a real valid positive response.

allowed_summary: Goal5332 adds an app-owned intake runner for future normalized X-HD external response JSON. It creates auditable case directories and reuses the Goal5330 validator.
not_allowed: claiming any real external response has arrived from Goal5332 alone
claiming external artifacts have been acquired
claiming ACM supplement has been inspected
